features_description: Shared learned action scorer; per-candidate goal offsets/distance bins, progress, memory occupancy/visits/age/block counts and sensor rays. Fixed encoding has no action scores, paths, masks or teacher. All five actions remain possible.

escalation.trigger: Best new success fraction below 0.70 on the same 24 development cases

selection: Highest success count, then original mean return, then fewer Wait actions, then lower action budget; deterministic first candidate breaks exact ties. New verified complete checkpoints only. Development selection is optimistic, not unseen accuracy.
training_reward: Official reward + 0.2*(old Manhattan distance - new Manhattan distance), only when progress-v1 selected; not claimed policy invariant under gamma=.99. Evaluation always original official reward.
